metadata.title: Settings | HabitParty
metadata.description: Manage your profile, appearance, audio alerts, subscription, and account security.

headerSubtitle: Manage your profile, preferences, subscription, appearance, and account security.

unsavedGuard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedGuard.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. If you switch tabs now without saving, your edits will be lost.

cards.profileDesc: Manage your name, birth date, and platform identity.
cards.appearanceThemeDesc: Choose from 4 free themes (2 dark and 2 light) or unlock exclusive VIP atmospheric palettes.
cards.experienceMode: Experience Profile (Essential Mode vs. Adventure Mode)
cards.experienceModeDesc: Choose your gamification style: clean executive interface with credits and points in Essential Mode, or RPG immersion with gold coins, XP, and mystery boxes in Adventure Mode.
cards.routineDesc: Adjust your daily focus target, peak energy period, discipline style, and primary goals set during onboarding.
cards.languageDesc: Choose the display language for all menus, dashboards, and notifications across HabitParty.
cards.dateFormatDesc: Choose how dates are formatted across calendars, task deadlines, focus records, and history.
cards.timeFormatDesc: Choose how times are displayed in selectors, task deadlines, focus records, and history.
cards.timezoneDesc: Defines when your midnight occurs for daily resets, streak calculations, and task reminders.
cards.welcomeCardsDesc: Manage which welcome cards and quick guides remain visible across app screens.
cards.audioDesc: Customize click sound effects, Pomodoro completion alarms, and relaxing soundscapes.
cards.subscriptionDesc: Manage your active plan, cosmic quotas, renewals, and payment method.
cards.privacyDesc: Control who can view your showcase, statistics, achievements, and send friend requests.
cards.changePasswordDesc: Update your account password. Choose a strong password with letters, numbers, and symbols.
cards.accountResetDesc: Restart your journey by clearing only metrics and achievements, or wiping all content without creating a new account.
cards.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your account will permanently wipe all your data, tasks, coins, items, and history on HabitParty. This action is irreversible.

theme.solar-parchmentDesc: Warm ivory parchment, botanical pine-teal, and harvest gold with high editorial contrast for long reading sessions.
theme.cyberpunk-neonDesc: Deep midnight navy with electric cyan, vibrant magenta, and neon yellow accents for high-energy night sessions.
theme.forest-rangerDesc: Deep canopy moss with emerald accents and warm lantern amber. Organic calm inspired by RPG rangers.
theme.royal-goldDesc: Silk ivory porcelain, imperial amber, and crown gold with royal burgundy accents. Daylight sophistication exclusive to VIP.

dangerZone.warningNote: This permanently removes your account, tasks, rewards, history, and achievements and cannot be undone.
dangerZone.modalDesc: Are you sure you want to delete your HabitParty account? All your progress, history, achievements, and settings will be deleted immediately and cannot be recovered.
dangerZone.activeSubscriptionAutoCancelNotice: You have an active recurring Stripe subscription. Confirming deletion will automatically cancel it first so you are not billed again.

accountReset.metricsDesc: Clears XP, level, coins/gold, overall streak, achievements, profile highlights, and task streaks/focus counters. You can choose in the confirmation modal whether to delete transaction history and focus records too. Your workspaces, board columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, backpack items, and subscription stay intact.
accountReset.metricsModalDesc: This will permanently reset your XP, coins, overall streak, achievements, profile highlights, and task streaks/counters. By default, your transaction statement and logged focus sessions stay preserved — check the box below only if you want to erase them too.
accountReset.metricsSuccessToast: Metrics, XP, and achievements have been reset!
accountReset.deleteHistoryLabel: Also delete Transaction History and focus records
accountReset.deleteHistoryHint: Removes your entire earnings/spending ledger and logged focus sessions. When unchecked, only counters, XP, coins, and achievements are reset.
accountReset.completeDesc: Deletes all content created by you (workspaces, columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, inventory, focus activities & logs, transactions, achievements, and notifications) and clears bio/avatar frame, while keeping your login, friends, and active subscription.
accountReset.completeModalTitle: Delete all data and start from scratch?
accountReset.completeModalDesc: This action permanently deletes all your workspaces, columns, tasks, checklists, rewards, items, focus activities & records, transactions, achievements, and bio/frame. Your login credentials, email, friends, and active subscription stay preserved so you do not have to sign up again.
accountReset.completeConfirmInputLabel: To confirm the complete reset, type {keyword} below:
accountReset.completeSuccessToast: Account completely reset! Ready for a fresh start.

perks: Schedule To-Dos as Events (start & end times or all-day)
Exclusive animated frames for your profile and avatar
3 exclusive VIP atmospheric themes (Cyberpunk Neon, Forest Ranger, and Royal Gold)
Pomodoro ambient sounds (Gentle Rain, Coffee Shop, Campfire, Zen Lofi)
Exclusive VIP icon pack for activities and columns
Up to 4 independent Workspaces — double the free tier
Up to 6 Lists/Columns per board for complete workflows
VIP Cosmic Guardian badge on profile and golden ring
